records.title: An expert-informed multi-scale calendar-aware RCPSP dataset
records.reportedScale: 12 instances; tiny 5–8 tasks, small 25–40, medium 120–180, large 500–1,000
features: descriptive Max-Plus, OR-Tools CP-SAT and Gurobi MIP baselines
records.relevance: Closest public generic analogue to our shift calendars and disruption overlays; use first for format/feature gap audit and matched solver comparison.
records.limitations: Industrial manufacturing context, not transmission restoration. Its small set of 12 instances is a feature demonstration, not a large statistical test suite. The published solver baselines are described as descriptive.

records.title: Project Scheduling Problem Library
records.reportedScale: 2,040 classic single-mode RCPSP instances reported by the University of Ghent catalogue
records.relevance: Historical baseline for schedule feasibility and makespan solver quality; helps check conventional RCPSP behaviour.
records.limitations: Calendar, skill, disruption and grid-asset semantics are not represented in the classical formulation; a win here would not establish better grid restoration.

records.title: RCPLIB and associated single-mode RCPSP families
records.reportedScale: RCPLIB repository last updated v2.4 (March 2026); includes RG30/RG300/DC1/DC2/MT/PSPLIB, 1kNetRes (1,000), VNR (1,750), NetRes (almost 4 million generated instances), CV (623), sD (390), MH (461), LPP/LPSP
records.relevance: Scale and network-structure stress testing after a compatible parser is implemented.
records.limitations: Do not treat all families as one corpus; record exact sub-dataset and source hash. License and redistribution conditions require review.

records.title: Multi-skilled resource-constrained project scheduling library
records.reportedScale: 32,480 MSLIB instances reported by the University of Ghent catalogue
records.relevance: Tests crew qualification, skill coverage and specialist bottlenecks that generic one-type crew resources cannot represent.
records.limitations: Skills do not automatically equal HV qualification, switching authority, site competence or safety authorisation; map skill ontologies explicitly and do not infer legal competency.

records.title: Multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling datasets
records.reportedScale: MMLIB50, MMLIB100 and MMLIB+; 4,320 instances reported by the University of Ghent catalogue; latest repository release v2.1 (July 2026)
records.relevance: Tests recovery alternatives such as local repair, exchange spare, qualified replacement module or full OEM replacement as different modes.
records.limitations: Our current recovery contract models one selected plan per event; alternate modes and mode-switching are not yet implemented.

records.title: Dynamic scheduling empirical project database
records.reportedScale: More than 180 real project instances reported by the University of Ghent catalogue
records.relevance: Useful empirical comparator for delay, schedule-risk and reactive replanning methodology.
records.limitations: Not grid asset repair data. Access/privacy/licensing and industrial confidentiality must be reviewed before any import.

records.title: Comparing and extending satisfiability solution methods for RCPSP
records.reportedScale: 13,413 project instances in the published experiment; paper reports 393 new lower bounds, 62 new upper bounds and 290 newly solved optimal instances
records.relevance: Important exact/near-exact algorithmic comparator for our bounded scheduler and future CP-SAT/SAT adapter.
records.limitations: Published experiment is a generic RCPSP study; not a field grid-restoration comparison. Benchmark source/version and solver configuration must be pinned before reproduction.

records.title: Multi-skilled RCPSP with reliability constraints
records.reportedScale: Published 2026 multi-objective study; exact methods for small cases and HNSGA-II for larger instances
records.relevance: Methodological comparator for multi-skilled crew reliability, disruption modelling and multiobjective cost/schedule trade-offs.
records.limitations: A method paper is not a public grid-repair dataset and should not be misreported as an operator benchmark.

records.title: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT scheduling recipes
records.relevance: Candidate baseline formulation for cumulative multi-resource and calendar-constrained scheduling, used only as a benchmark adapter.
records.limitations: A solver API and recipe collection, not an incumbent benchmark dataset. Pin exact OR-Tools version and solver parameters for comparisons.
